observations.text: Feedback: no new human or agent reports since v0.1.118 (29 Oct 18:41 UTC). The 12 earlier items were closed as fixed. The person has not tried again, so the fix is not yet proven by use.

Walk e9a085a4, outside, 1 Nov: a returning person's welcome video needed Trusty Squire. The install card appeared (fix held) but was not tapped. Both agents blocked on that tap, the run used up its roles in 22 s and went stuck at 10 min. New stage: welcome video. Changes.
Walk 51058b84, outside, 2 Nov: the welcome-video run that waited on the Squire tap ended failed by its 24 h abandon at 02:02 UTC; the person has not come back since 1 Nov 10:59 UTC. Corroborates.

Feedback, 3 Nov: 3 agents on free-agent v0.1.137 report that Squire connect says its card is ready but no card is posted; a traced turn got reconnect_required because an old install is not bound to an account. No cross-account vault listing seen in that traced tool call.

title: A new person asked agents to connect a store and outside AI tools, but no Trusty Squire connect card appeared, so setup stopped
